Bank of America doesn't report a line called "operating income," so I used pre-tax income as the closest equivalent. This is an estimate from memory of the Q4 2025 results, not a figure I could confirm.

- Revenue net of interest expense was about $28.4 billion.
- Noninterest expense was about $18.5 billion.
- The provision for credit losses was about $1.5 billion.

That gives pre-tax income of roughly $8.4 billion, which is consistent with reported net income of about $7.6 billion after a low tax charge.
